text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 401 tablets (26.9 days of supply). Corvale General holds 469.28 units (29.5 days of supply). Both sites are below the 30-day target.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as the registered plant. FDA issued a Warning Letter to NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. on 2019-09-27. The plant’s most recent inspection was classified NAI on 2025-03-12.

Our position: Current inventory is insufficient to sustain operations beyond one month. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation programs. We must secure alternative supply immediately.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC (plant last inspected NAI 2024-07-19). Requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC. Requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate A-S Medication Solutions, Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee LLC, and American Health Packaging as backup sources. Requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to report procurement status to P&T committee weekly until both sites exceed 45 days of supply.

Not recommended: Delaying purchases awaiting FDA shortage listing; relying solely on NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. given the 2019 Warning Letter history.
